en-US.name: Global Radio Explorer
en-US.summary: Stream thousands of live radio stations from around the world.
en-US.description: Global Radio Explorer plays live internet radio from cities and countries worldwide. Ask for a station by name, for example "play Chennai radio", or ask to play a city like "play stations from Berlin". Handy for travel, expats, and anyone who wants to hear the world.
examplePhrases: Alexa, play Chennai radio on global radio
Alexa, ask global radio to play a station
